intent: Change and progress over ordered samples as a line or area chart.
useWhen: Following a trajectory across time or sequence
Parts of a total over time, like usage by plan by month — variant area with stack stacked
Each part's share of the total over time — variant area with stack percent
doNotUseWhen: Comparing unrelated magnitudes at one moment — use BarChart
Part-to-whole share at one moment — use PieChart

stack.note: Only with variant area. stacked piles the series as bands from the bottom up, so the top edge is the total; percent scales each column to 100% so the bands show each series' share. Missing or negative values count as 0. Ignored with variant line, with a warning in development

curve.note: smooth rounds the line through every point (monotone: no overshoot above peaks or below dips); linear draws straight segments

tickInterval.note: draw every Nth axis label; with neither tickInterval nor formatLabel, labels thin automatically only when they would overlap

formatLabel.note: (label, index) => string for the painted axis label; return '' to hide one (turns off automatic thinning). Table and accessible names keep the raw label

animate.note: Lines draw in left to right and area fills fade in after when the chart first appears. Runs when the chart mounts; changing data on a mounted chart does not replay it. To replay (e.g. one chart per Tabs panel, or a range switcher), give the chart a key that changes with the data. Off under prefers-reduced-motion

requirements: The plot svg is role=group named by the title when it holds focusable points (role=img only when empty)
animate is decorative only: no motion under prefers-reduced-motion, and hover, focus, legend and table work during the entrance

doNot: Do not invent chart container cousins
Do not draw bars and a line on one chart from two charts — use ComboChart
Do not stack series that can go negative; a stacked band starts where the one below ends, so a negative value has nowhere to go
Do not stack values that do not add up to a real total, like rates, averages or overlapping counts; use stack none
Do not set stack with variant line; stacking needs filled bands
snippet:
<LineChart title="Weekly active users" variant="area" data={[{ label: 'Mon', value: 1240 }]} />

<LineChart
  title="Usage by plan"
  variant="area"
  stack="stacked"
  labels={['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar']}
  series={[
    { label: 'Free', data: [1200, 1350, 1410] },
    { label: 'Pro', data: [640, 720, 810] },
  ]}
/>
